title: A Short Creed
author: al-ghazali
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the edition and the scholarly consensus give; the catalogue does not adjudicate disputed cases.
description: A compact statement of Ash'ari belief, setting out what a Muslim is to affirm about God, prophecy and the last things. Al-Ghazali wrote it as a summary for ordinary believers rather than as a scholastic treatise, which makes it the clearest short statement of the theology behind his longer works.
historicalContext: Translated by Duncan Black Macdonald in 1903 as an appendix to his study of Muslim theology, jurisprudence and constitutional theory. The translation is public domain and is reproduced by Wikisource.
availabilityNote: Streamed from Wikisource page by page at read time. The 1903 translation by Duncan Black Macdonald is public domain; the page text is served by Wikisource under its own terms.
